To further investigate the issue, I will analyze the code snippet provided by the function call to get_code_snippet(tqdm._tqdm.tqdm.__init__) which shows that when the total number of iterations is None (i.e., it's unknown), tqdm does not display any progress statistics. However, in this specific case, the test expected to see a certain message ("100it" in the file contents) indicating that some progress information was being displayed.

Upon closer inspection, I notice that the issue lies in the fact that when total is None (i.e., it's unknown), tqdm behaves as if it's equal to 0. This means that no progress statistics will be displayed, which explains why the test failed.

The problematic part of the code snippet provided by get_code_snippet(tqdm._tqdm.tqdm.__init__) can be found at lines 716-720 and 818-821 where it's handling the case when total is None. The issue lies in the fact that when total is None, tqdm should not try to display any progress statistics.
